text:
alana: quick heads-up — support saw duplicate provisioning calls during onboarding when a 429 coincided with token refresh. small batch but high customer impact.
ben: do we have a sanitized trace? want to confirm client-side replay vs server reprocess.
sophie: pasted sanitized snippet from the dump:
```
2026-04-05T16:02:10Z req_id=zzz-001 status=429 retry-after=0.3
2026-04-05T16:02:10Z sdk retried req_id=zzz-001 idempotency_key=none
2026-04-05T16:02:11Z server processed provision_resource idempotency_key=none
```
ben: yep classic race during refresh. couple of low-risk mitigations: (1) sample app defaults should attach an Idempotency-Key for mutating endpoints (opt-out), (2) SDKs should implement a short replay-guard window around auth refresh (default 30s) and jittered exponential backoff that honors Retry-After, (3) add a tiny, low-cardinality sampling marker so infra can correlate a few throttled/replayed requests for debugging.
alana: for sampling headers I suggest two lightweight fields only when sampling triggers: `X-Rw-Throttle-Sample: 1` and `X-Rw-Sample-Info: v=1;sdk=js;tag=throttle` — no payloads, no user ids. infra can index boolean+short tag for a short retention window.
sophie: agree. also add a note: streaming/generation endpoints should NOT auto-generate idempotency keys or nonces by default. partial outputs make automatic dedupe risky. document explicit opt-in.
ben: pseudo SDK example for sample apps:
```js
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = opts.idempotencyKey || uuidv4()
if (duringRefresh && shouldSample()) {
  headers['X-Rw-Throttle-Sample'] = '1'
  headers['X-Rw-Sample-Info'] = 'v1;sdk=node;tag=throttle-retry'
}
await retryWithBackoff({baseMs:200, maxMs:30000, jitter:true, honorRetryAfter:true, safeReplayWindowMs:30000})
```
alana: action items: 1) devex to propose RFC for sample-app defaults + SDK parity (autoIdempotency, safeReplayWindow, sampleRate) — assignee @alana; 2) infra/runtime to accept and index `X-Rw-Throttle-Sample` boolean and short tag pre-scrub (owner: infra) with short retention; 3) SDK teams to add opt-out flags and update sample apps; 4) docs/devrel to add streaming exceptions and onboarding guidance.
ci-bot: created issue devex-1301: "sample-app idempotency + throttle-sampling RFC" (assignee: @alana) :spiral_note_pad:
sophie: RFC should include compatibility plan: servers treat absent idempotency headers as no guarantee, and we shouldn't change semantics for older SDKs. also add privacy checklist for sampled telemetry.
ben: once RFC lands we'll do small PRs across sample-apps to demonstrate the config and reduce support noise.
alana: thanks — will draft and link here. :thumbsup:
